visible_title_generation_rule.formula: Canonical Role + RFP Topic + Management Question + Primary Executive Audience
visible_title_generation_rule.default_behavior: Use canonical Arabic default as a safe baseline, then adapt only when the RFP evidence supports a more specific management implication.
visible_title_generation_rule.owner_language_lock: Arabic visible executive titles/subsections/callouts/decision labels/artifact labels must not use the prohibited exposure term variants unless an engagement-specific owner approval is explicitly recorded.
visible_title_generation_rule.cfo_evidence_rule: Profitability or cash-flow wording is permitted only when source evidence or analysis genuinely supports the dimension.
